The bug is the modulo: `Families[(i+1)%(len(Families)-1)]` wraps around at 5 instead of 6, so the last family in the cycle (`cucurbits`) is never reached — a bed coming after `alliums`... actually a bed at `nightshades` (index 4) advances to index 5 % 5 = 0 (`brassicas`), skipping `cucurbits`. It should be `% len(Families)`.
